title: Poor Ian!
description: A dialogue lesson on the future tense with 'shall/will' and 'be going to'. Three neighbours (Catherine, Jenny, and Linda) discuss Ian, who has just sold his house and is moving tomorrow afternoon. Jenny has always known Ian as a good neighbour and will see him today to give him their regards. The twist: Ian didn't want to leave, but his wife did! New vocabulary includes still, move, miss, neighbour, person, people, and poor. Workbook practice covers completing the dialogue (fill in missing words) and sorting nouns by plural pronunciation. Grammar exercises practise replacing 'am/is/are going to' with 'shall/will' and completing dialogues using the cues given.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Who wanted to sell the house) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (complete dialogue) 17 blanks are taken from the supplied Lesson 91 key (img/key-091-095.jpg). Practice B (plural nouns) 20 words are taken from the supplied Lesson 91 key (img/key-091-095.jpg). Grammar I (replace am/is/are going to with shall/will) 10 items are taken from the supplied Lesson 91 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 507). Grammar II (complete the dialogues) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 91 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 507). No external sources were used.

lesson-091-scene-01.description: Three women (Catherine, Jenny, and Linda) stand outside a house with a 'FOR SALE' sign in the window, talking about Ian who is moving out.
lesson-091-scene-01.reason: Odd lesson: text first; illustration deferred.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question. Who wanted to sell the house?
听录音，然后回答问题。谁想卖房？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the question: Who wanted to sell the house?

lines.speaker: CATHERINE
lines.text: Has Ian sold his house yet?
lines.translation: 凯瑟琳：伊恩已把他的房子卖掉了吗？

lines.speaker: JENNY
lines.text:
Yes, he has.
He sold it last week.
lines.translation: 詹尼：是的，卖掉了。他上星期卖掉的。

lines.speaker: CATHERINE
lines.text: Has he moved to his new house yet?
lines.translation: 凯瑟琳：他已经迁进新居了吗？

lines.speaker: JENNY
lines.text:
No, not yet.
He's still here.
He's going to move tomorrow.
lines.translation: 詹尼：不，还没有。他仍在这里。他打算明天搬家。

lines.speaker: CATHERINE
lines.translation: 凯瑟琳：什么时候？明天上午吗？

lines.speaker: JENNY
lines.text:
No. Tomorrow afternoon.
I'll miss him.
He has always been a good neighbour.
lines.translation: 詹尼：不，明天下午。我会想念他的。他一直是把好邻居。

lines.speaker: LINDA
lines.text:
He's a very nice person.
We'll all miss him.
lines.translation: 琳达：他是个非常好的人，我们大家都会想念他的。

lines.speaker: CATHERINE
lines.text: When will the new people move into this house?
lines.translation: 凯瑟琳：新住户什么时候搬进这所房子？

lines.speaker: JENNY
lines.text:
I think that they'll move in
the day after tomorrow.
lines.translation: 詹尼：我想他们将在后天搬进来吧。

lines.speaker: LINDA
lines.text: Will you see Ian today, Jenny?
lines.translation: 琳达：詹尼，您今天会见到伊恩吗？

lines.speaker: CATHERINE
lines.text:
Poor Ian!
He didn't want to leave this house.
lines.translation: 凯瑟琳：可怜的伊恩！他本不想离开这幢房子。

lines.speaker: JENNY
lines.text:
No, he didn't want to leave,
but his wife did!
lines.translation: 詹尼：是啊，他是不想离开，可是他妻子要离开。

lesson.title: Listen then answer this question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Who wanted to sell the house? 听录音，然后回答问题。谁想卖房？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer: Who wanted to sell the house?

questions.prompt: Who wanted to sell the house?
questions.answer: Ian's wife wanted to sell the house. Ian didn't want to leave, but his wife did.

items.title: No, not yet
items.text:
No, not yet. 不，还没有。
这是简略回答，完整的回答是 He hasn't moved to his new house yet.

items.title: He's a very nice person
items.text: He's a very nice person. 他是一个非常 好的人。person 是指人。当需要表示复数形式时，往往用 people 这个词。如后面的一句话 When will the new people move into this house?

items.title: Please give him my regards
items.text: Please give him my regards. 请代我问候他。

items.title: No, he didn't want to leave ...
items.text: No, he didn't want to leave ... 是对上一句话的证实。由于上一句话中用了否定形式，因此，在证实时句中的动词不可模仿前一句话的形式，而要根据事实来决定。但在译成汉语时，No 就要译成肯定的意思，如："是的，他不想离开。"

grammar.title: I. Replace "am/is/are going to" with "shall/will". 用 shall/will 替换 am/is/are going to。
grammar.instruction: Replace "am/is/are going to" with "shall/will". 用 shall/will 替换 am/is/are going to。
grammar.translation: Rewrite each sentence, replacing 'am/is/are going to' with 'shall' or 'will'.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 10 items. All answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 91 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 507).

questions.prompt: 1. The bus is going to take you to your school.
questions.answer: The bus will take you to your school.

questions.prompt: 2. He's going to do his homework tomorrow.
questions.answer: He will do his homework tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 3. We're going to have a meeting next Wednesday.
questions.answer: We will/shall have a meeting next Wednesday.

questions.prompt: 4. It's going to rain today.
5. We're going to have another English lesson tomorrow afternoon.
questions.answer: We will/shall have another English lesson tomorrow afternoon.

questions.prompt: 6. Susan is going to move into her new house the day after tomorrow.
questions.answer: Susan will move into her new house the day after tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 7. They're going to enjoy themselves on their holiday next month.
questions.answer: They will enjoy themselves on their holiday next month.

questions.prompt: 8. You're going to meet them tomorrow evening.
questions.answer: You will meet them tomorrow evening.

questions.prompt: 9. I'm going to go back home next weekend.
questions.answer: I will/shall go back home next weekend.

questions.prompt: 10. We're going to have a big party tomorrow night.
questions.answer: We will/shall have a big party tomorrow night.

grammar.title: II. Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。
grammar.instruction:
Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。

Example (item 1):
I/break my pencil/I/give you another one
What's the matter? — I've broken my pencil.
It doesn't matter. — I'll give you another one.
grammar.translation: Complete each dialogue using the cues in parentheses, following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf

questions.prompt:
1. I/break my pencil/I/give you another one
What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: I've broken my pencil. / I'll give you another one.

questions.prompt:
2. I/lose my umbrella/I/buy you a new one
What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: I've lost my umbrella. / I'll buy you a new one.

questions.prompt:
3. they/lose their way/the policeman/help them
What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: They've lost their way. / The policeman will help them.

questions.prompt:
4. I/have a bad stomachache for two days/we/take you to the doctor's
What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: I've had a bad stomachache for two days. / We'll take you to the doctor's.

questions.prompt:
5. she/not get up yet/she/get up soon
What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: She hasn't got up yet. / She'll get up soon.

questions.prompt:

What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: My son's lost his book. / I'll buy him a new one.

questions.prompt:
7. we/not finish our homework yet/you/do it tomorrow
What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: We haven't finished our homework yet. / You'll do it tomorrow.

questions.prompt:
8. she/lose her pen/I/lend her a pencil
What's the matter? — ______
It doesn't matter. — ______
questions.answer: She's lost her pen. / I'll lend her a pencil.
